question: Which platform staff may read across organizations or operate shared platform services, under what mandate, scope, expiry and audit?
decision: No standing cross-tenant data access. A purpose-limited, named-person, named-tenant mandate is issued by a different authorized approver; default expiry 24 hours, absolute maximum 7 days with justification. Every privileged read, write, export and denial is tamper-evidently logged and visible to the affected tenant subject to security safeguards. Break-glass is at most 4 hours, restricted to a documented emergency, with immediate alert and independent post-event review; no self-approval or blanket platform_lead bypass.
originalProposedDecision: Platform staff have no standing cross-org access. Access is through a mandate issued per person, per org (or a named set), per purpose, expiring in at most 7 days, approved by a second staff member, with every read audited and visible to the org's admins. Break-glass: one person, 4 hours, reviewed afterwards. Replace platform_lead and isPlatformAdminUser checks with the mandate check.
